admission.justification: Skill and template must report the same actual state so a card corpus is not mistaken for authored knowledge.

applicability: Bootstrap handoff at the actual moment it reports cards, fixer, attributed baseline and knowledge state.
conditions: A clean tree dry run means no remaining citation-table authoring and no refused card.
Knowledge before the first memory revision reports context-not-admitted/memory_revision_unavailable; absent knowledge after adoption reports not-recorded.
The actual product next step is carried for each state.
exclusions: Declaring foundation completion because cards or a baseline exist.
Changing product state to match an inaccurate example in prose.
Confusing onboarding/bootstrap audit retention with transient memory-root/bootstrap staging.

evidence: journey read-back (cards, sidecars bcc0d9df commit, text/v2 read) + composed journey test proving both knowledge moments (context-not-admitted/memory_revision_unavailable pre-baseline, not-recorded post-baseline); architect ruling rule 5(a) notes/run3/L45-THE-HAND-OFF-NAMES-THE-STATE-MEMORY-INIT-REPORTS-AT-THAT-MOMENT-RULING.json

statement: The bootstrap hand-off names which cards exist, a clean fixer dry run, the baseline state, and the knowledge state memory_init reports at that moment with its named next step, never claiming a foundation because cards exist.
